newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Sheikh Zaid of UAE to U.S. for medical checks.
newsitem.headline: Sheikh Zaid of UAE to U.S. for medical checks.

text.p: United Arab Emirates President Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan, who was on a private visit to Morocco, left Rabat on Monday for Washington where he is expected to undergo a medical checkup, an official source said.
"Sheikh Zaid is leaving for Washington on a private visit and to undergo a medical checkup," a member of the official delegation accompanying the UAE leader said. He would not give further details.
Moroccan King Hassan's youngest son Moulay Rachid accompanied the sheikh, who walked slowly with a cane in his left hand, to the UAE Airbus plane.
